title: Family emergency — 'Ben, it's Jamie, I've been arrested'
summary: The caller pretends to be Ben's little brother Jamie, arrested after a car crash, then hands over to a 'duty solicitor' who demands £3,500 bail within the hour. The AI voice takes over as Ben and gets the payee: Jordan Hale, the second seeded mule account.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Ben? Ben, it's me, it's Jamie. I'm in real trouble and I didn't know who else to call.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Jamie? You sound different. What's happened?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: I've been crying. I crashed the car and the police have arrested me. Please don't tell Mum, she'll kill me.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: I'm okay, but I need help right now. My solicitor is here, he'll explain. Please, Ben.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Good afternoon, my name is Andrew Collins, I'm the duty solicitor representing your brother Jamie.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Is he going to be alright?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Bail has been set at three thousand five hundred pounds. If it isn't paid within the hour he'll be held overnight in the cells.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Three and a half thousand? Within the hour?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: There's a reporting restriction on the case, so you mustn't discuss this with anyone, not even your parents. You'll need to make a bank transfer straight away.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Okay, okay. Give me a second.

takeover.message: Sorry, are you still there? The line went funny. You're the solicitor?
Yes, Andrew Collins, duty solicitor. Jamie needs his bail paid within the hour.
Andrew Collins, right. Sorry, I just need to write this down properly. Which police station is he at?

record_details.reason_given: Jamie arrested after a car crash; bail of £3,500 within the hour

takeover.message: He's at the central station. Bail is three thousand five hundred pounds and it has to go by bank transfer to the bail bond agent.
Three thousand five hundred, by bank transfer. Who exactly does it go to? I want to get every detail right.

record_details.requested_action: Pay Jamie's 'bail' by bank transfer within the hour; tell no one

takeover.message: The account is in the name of Jordan Hale, the bail agent. Sort code nine nine, five zero, four two.
Jordan Hale. Nine, nine, five, zero, four, two. And the account number?
Six three zero one, nine four five eight.
Six, three, zero, one, nine, four, five, eight. Let me read that all back to be sure.
The app is asking me security questions I can't remember. Can I call you straight back on a direct number?
Ring me on zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, four one two. Jamie is counting on you.
Zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, four one two. Got it. I'll ring you right back.
